latest_release.name: Penny 3.3.1
latest_release.body:
**New: "Looks recurring", a sidebar panel that lists the bills you pay every month, found from your own entries.**

## Changes
- **Looks recurring.** Penny now notices the bills you pay every month and lists them for you. You don't have to set anything up. Each row shows:
  - the usual amount and the usual day;
  - the evidence, for example "seen 5 of 6 months";
  - "paid this month", when this month's payment matches.
- **Strict by design.** A bill appears only when it has about the same amount (within 10%) and about the same day (within a week) in at least 4 of the last 6 months, and at most once in any month. Penny would rather miss a bill than show a wrong one.
- **Read-only and private.** The panel only reads the expenses you already have. Nothing is saved or changed, and nothing is sent anywhere. Penny still has no third-party code, and the security policy is unchanged.
- **Follows the month picker.** Pick another month to see the bills as they stood then.
- **Sample data shows it working.** A first-time visit, or a Reset, now includes past-month entries for Rent, Train pass and a Music subscription. The sample now has 24 expenses, and this month's sample total is unchanged.

## Before you upgrade
Nothing stored in your browser changes. Data, CSV and JSON formats are frozen, and a golden-file test proves it. The panel needs about 4 months of history before it can show your own bills. Until then it says what it is looking for.

## Why 3.3.1 and not 3.4.0
This is the first step of a recurring-bills arc. 3.3.2 adds due bills and one-tap add, and 3.4 adds a forecast. The version number counts towards that arc.

## Verification
- **Tests:** 692 automated tests pass, locally and in CI. They include 46 detector tests and golden-file checks that the data formats and security headers are unchanged.
- **Browser checks:**
  - the panel on sample data;
  - the month picker;
  - the empty state;
  - a 375 px phone width, keyboard and screen reader;
  - the owner's smoke test.
- **Live site:** all 11 runtime files on GitHub Pages match this release.
- **Review:** built by a Sonnet 5.5 subagent and reviewed independently by Opus 5.5. Every finding was fixed before merge.
- **Real-data check:** run on the owner's own backup, the detector made no wrong calls. There is only about a month of real history so far, so how many real bills it finds can't be measured yet. The automated tests are the gate for this release.

## Assets
- `PennyExpenseManager-v3.3.1.zip`: the full source at this tag. Its SHA-256 checksum is in the `.sha256` file.

Live app: https://debasisr66.github.io/PennyExpenseManager/
Details: [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/debasisr66/PennyExpenseManager/blob/v3.3.1/CHANGELOG.md)
